why_it_exists: Microsoft holds an approximately 25% as-converted equity-method interest in OpenAI, which makes OpenAI a related party under ASC 850 and compels the disclosure. It is a consequence of the accounting for the stake, not a decision to report AI revenue.
covers: Revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, inclusive of revenue-sharing payments. Chiefly Azure compute sold to OpenAI plus the revenue share Microsoft receives, which is economically downstream of OpenAI's own product revenue.
excludes: All AI revenue from every other customer: Copilot, Foundry, and Azure AI sold to anyone who is not OpenAI. This is a floor on Microsoft's AI revenue, not a measure of it, and it is not the AI revenue proxy the model computes.
